economy.label: Экономия
economy.rule: Choose the lowest expected total cost of an accepted result.

balance.label: Баланс
balance.rule: Prefer one tier higher when redo risk is material and verification is weak.

highResponsibility.label: Высокая ответственность
highResponsibility.rule: Use the defined quality floor and current authoritative sources for consequential decisions.

doNotUseFor: exceptionally ambiguous or consequential work without strong verification
routine bounded tasks with deterministic checks
work where a cheaper tier plus deterministic verification is reliable
limitations: Fast is unavailable with EU data residency

speed.note: Fast costs more; do not reduce model quality to obtain speed.

qualityFloors.routineFinancialSpreadsheet: GPT-5.6 Terra · High with formula checks
qualityFloors.medicalLegalFinancialSafetyCritical: GPT-5.6 Sol · High or greater with current authoritative sources
qualityFloors.highestComplexityEndToEnd: GPT-6 Astra · High when long-horizon complexity or weak verification makes a cheaper tier likely to fail

sessionFeedback.accepted: Keep or consider one cheaper tier for a similarly bounded task.
sessionFeedback.reworked: Raise the relevant quality floor or ask the missing clarifier next time.
sessionFeedback.tooExpensive: Look first for safe context reduction, decomposition, or deterministic verification.
sessionFeedback.wrongModel: Name the specific failure mode and adjust only that boundary.

nativeLimitations: Cannot read text before it is sent.
Cannot switch the active model, effort, or speed automatically.
Cannot persist feedback reliably between chats without an external store.
